title: "The Voice of the Scribe"
next_chapter_hook: "Cang Yutian's divine sense quietly probed like spider silk, and Chen Ji felt an icy chill envelop his entire body—he had been exposed."

text.content: "Just as Chen Ji was about to press for the whereabouts of the fifth page, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul revealed a look of terror for the first time—something was following their conversation. Mo Xiansheng's shadow twisted intensely, his voice urgent and panicked: 'No, this aura—Chen Ji, quickly sever the resonance with the Tianji Record!' But it was already too late."

dialogue.content: "'Interesting.' A cold voice suddenly rang out, not from Mo Xiansheng's mouth, but piercing through the Tianji Record's restrictions like thunder exploding in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea. That voice carried not a trace of emotion, yet it seemed to be scrutinizing ants: 'A broken chessboard, a fish that slipped through the net... you have traveled further than I anticipated.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt a formless force invade his Mental Sea, as if another pair of eyes were peering through his soul at everything. That power was ancient and vast, freezing his entire body, making even a finger impossible to move. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered madly, seemingly struggling against some kind of erosion, his voice hoarse: 'The Scribe... no, the will projection of the Eye of Heavenly Fate—why would it appear now!'"

dialogue.content: "'Mo.' The cold voice rang out again, carrying an arrogant pressure: 'You are but a wisp of remnant soul, and you dare obstruct this seat's projection?' Before the words finished, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst with dazzling golden light, forcibly suppressing Mo Xiansheng's shadow back into the depths of the pages. Then, the voice turned to Chen Ji: 'Raise your head. Let this seat have a proper look—at the only ant in a thousand years who dared to pry into Heavenly Secrets.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt an irresistible force lifting his chin, his gaze forced to meet a formless will. In that moment of confrontation, he saw clearly—it was not a true form, but a pair of giant eyes woven from countless threads of fate, suspended in the void of his Mental Sea, coldly watching him. 'Waste? Orphan of the Chen family? Inheritor of the Tianji Record?' The voice carried a faint mockery: 'Heh... you certainly disguised yourself well.'"

choice.prompt: "How should Chen Ji respond to the scrutiny of the Eye of Heavenly Fate's will projection?"

choices.description: "Temporarily lower your head and show weakness, not exposing your true nature, waiting for the right moment"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve your trump cards, letting the opponent underestimate you"
choices.risk_hint: "The opponent may see through the disguise"

text.content: "Chen Ji lowered his eyelids,收敛ing all his sharpness beneath a calm exterior. He did not struggle, did not rage, only speaking in a tone almost bordering on humility: 'Elder is absolutely right. The junior is merely an ant who happened to obtain a fragment. How could I have the virtue to pry into Heavenly Secrets?' The moment the words fell, those eyes of fate narrowed slightly, seemingly quite satisfied with his compliance."

dialogue.content: "'Oh?' The voice carried a hint of playfulness: 'You are smarter than those self-righteous fools. Since you know the times so well, this seat shall grant you an opportunity—hand over clues to the fifth page, and this seat may promise you glory for a lifetime.'"

choices.description: "Remain composed, neither servile nor arrogant, facing this so-called Heavenly Will as an equal"
choices.visible_reward: "Display mettle, earning the Scribe's另行 regard"

text.content: "Chen Ji's spine slowly straightened, his chin that had been forcibly lifted becoming a provocation instead. He faced those eyes of fate, word by word: 'Elder calls me an ant, then pray tell—if an existence that governs Heavenly Fate has come personally to inquire about an ant's life or death, why?' At these words, the void trembled slightly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered intensely in the pages, as if startled and sighing."

dialogue.content: "Silence. Those eyes of fate gazed at Chen Ji for a long while before finally发出一声低沉的笑声: 'Interesting... for a thousand years, you are the first ant to dare straighten your spine before this seat.'"

choices.description: "Respond with absolute silence, neither showing weakness nor provocation, allowing the opponent no glimpse of your thoughts"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain mystery, giving the opponent no handle"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not speak. He merely stood there quietly, allowing those eyes of fate to scrutinize him, as if he were nothing but a stubborn stone, letting wind, frost, rain, and snow howl against him without stirring a single ripple. Silence spread through the Mental Sea. Those eyes narrowed slightly, seemingly reassessing this 'ant's' value. After a long while, that cold voice spoke again: 'You are quite the composed one.'"

"Just as the atmosphere thickened to the extreme, an异样波动 surged from the depths of the Tianji Record. It was neither Mo Xiansheng's aura nor the Eye of Heavenly Fate's pressure, but a more ethereal sound, as if coming from fate itself. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record in his hand suddenly burn hot. A certain fragment of pages flipped on its own, revealing a blank space previously unseen—and from within that blankness, a voice slowly arose."

dialogue.content: "'Enough.' That voice was ancient and weary, yet carried an unquestionable authority, completely different from Mo Xiansheng's usual tone: 'Since the Tianji Record has chosen its master, you have no right to overstep. Fate Scribe—or rather, Cang Yutian's third will lingering within the Tianji Record, you have overstepped.' At these words, those eyes of fate suddenly contracted, as if touching upon some taboo."

text.content: "Chen Ji's pupils slightly dilated. Cang Yutian—this name was not foreign to him. He was the first scribe who wielded the Tianji Record in ancient times. Legend held that he perished after glimpsing the truth of Heavenly Fate, yet no one ever knew the true reason for his fall. And now, an astonishing truth was gradually emerging: Cang Yutian had not truly perished. His will had been parasitic within the Tianji Record all along, waiting for a certain opportunity. And now, that opportunity seemed to be—himself."

dialogue.content: "'Heh.' The eyes of fate let out a low sneer, pressure intensifying rather than diminishing: 'Overstepped? This seat has held the brush for a thousand years, weaving fate beyond count. A mere wisp of remnant soul, and you presume to lecture this seat on overstepping?' The voice carried ancient arrogance, as if Heavenly Fate was merely a toy in his hands: 'You are but a fragment of Cang Yutian's dying执念—thinking you can prevent anything?'"

text.content: "The pages of the Tianji Record rustled violently, as if some force was surging between them. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul struggled desperately to break free, yet it was like a mayfly trying to shake a tree. Just as those eyes of fate were about to swallow Mo Xiansheng completely, a gentle yet resolute voice suddenly rang out—not from within the Tianji Record, but directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, as if someone had carved out a separate passage for him in the缝隙 of fate."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji.' That voice was gentle as spring breeze, yet each word was clear: 'Do not be fooled by appearances. Cang Yutian's layout seems airtight, yet there exist three fatal flaws—first, he cannot directly harm you, otherwise the Tianji Record's backlash would cause his complete dissolution; second, he also does not know the whereabouts of the fifth page, otherwise he would not be using your hand to search; third...' The voice paused slightly: 'He is急于 appearing precisely because he can no longer wait.'"

choice.prompt: "The Fate Scribe's guidance is clear and crucial. How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden assistance?"

choices.description: "Since the other party is willing to reveal more information, take the opportunity to inquire about more of Cang Yutian's weaknesses"
choices.visible_cost: "May expose that you urgently need help"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain crucial intelligence, accumulating筹码 for later confrontation with Cang Yutian"
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may just be using you"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji did not miss this opportunity, quickly organizing his words in his heart: 'What is the third flaw? May the Elder enlighten me.' The voice paused thoughtfully,，似乎在斟酌该说多少, then slowly said: 'The third flaw—Cang Yutian is impatient because the Eye of Heavenly Fate is about to complete its full takeover of the Tianji Record. He is merely a lingering remnant soul, making a pact with the tiger while thinking he controls the whole game... Your existence is his only variable.'"

choices.description: "Analyze calmly, not easily trusting this sudden kindness. There is no such thing as help without reason in this world"
choices.visible_reward: "See through the true intentions of all parties, avoiding becoming a chess piece"
choices.risk_hint: "The other party may walk away in anger"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji coldly spoke in his heart: 'Since Elder knows Cang Yutian's layout, why would you help me? There are many remnant souls within the Tianji Record—which one are you? And what do you seek?' The voice paused in surprise, then let out a low laugh: 'Good vigilance. Rest assured, I am merely a wisp of Cang Yutian's lingering执念, long no longer on the same path as him. Helping you is merely seeking—for myself a certain ending.'"

choices.description: "Since the other party knows the truth of fate, why not directly ask—what is true freedom?"
choices.visible_reward: "Touch upon the essence of fate, attaining spiritual elevation at the ideological level"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji did not inquire about the flaws, but asked the deepest confusion in his heart: 'Elder, if I act according to these flaws, I may temporarily escape—but will the final outcome still be on Cang Yutian's chessboard? What truly is freedom?' The voice fell into long silence, as if this question had touched upon some old wound. Finally, a sigh rang out: 'True freedom... is not choosing which path to take, but—refusing to be chosen.'"

text.content: "'Refusing to be chosen...' Chen Ji murmured, as if grasping some profound truth. The voice continued: 'Cang Yutian has preset three paths for you: either become his puppet, completing his unfinished business; or be erased by the Eye of Heavenly Fate, becoming an eternal warning; or—between these two dead ends, find the third path that none of the chess players anticipate.'"

dialogue.content: "'Enough!' The eyes of fate suddenly erupted with shocking pressure, the void trembling beneath this force: 'This seat shall see how long this wisp of remnant soul can struggle!' Before the words finished, a chain woven from countless threads of fate descended from the heavens, targeting Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul directly. At the same time, that gentle voice urgently sounded: 'Chen Ji, Cang Yutian has sensed the anomaly. The Eye of Heavenly Fate's surveillance is about to lock onto this place—remember, the fifth page is not far away, it has always been—'"

text.content: "The voice cut off abruptly. Chen Ji felt an icy chill suddenly flood into his Mental Sea, as if countless eyes were peering at him through some invisible crack. The pages of the Tianji Record trembled violently. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a pained groan, caught by that chain of fate, being dragged toward the abyss of those eyes of fate. And his connection with that mysterious voice was completely severed in the same instant."

choice.prompt: "Crisis suddenly descends! Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul is being dragged into the abyss. Chen Ji must make an immediate decision!"

choices.description: "Use Heavenly Fate as a cost to activate the Tianji Record's backlash power, forcibly severing the chain of fate"
choices.visible_reward: "Rescue Mo Xiansheng, gaining his complete inheritance"
choices.risk_hint: "May attract even more intense attention from the Eye of Heavenly Fate"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not hesitate for even a moment. He bit through his tongue sharply, spraying a mouthful of essence blood onto the Tianji Record, while channeling all his Heavenly Fate into that fragment. In an instant, the Tianji Record burst with dazzling golden light. A backlash force from the very source of Heavenly Fate erupted violently, snapping that chain of fate clean! Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul cried out, stumbling back into the depths of the pages."

choices.description: "Do not expose your trump cards, letting Mo Xiansheng be dragged away, preserving strength for a future counterattack"
choices.visible_reward: "Avoid exposing strength, not drawing the Eye of Heavenly Fate's key attention"

text.content: "Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly, but in the end, he did not move. He watched Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul being dragged inch by inch into the void by that chain of fate, watched those eyes of fate watching him with mockery—he silently recorded this scene in his heart, branding this debt deep into his marrow. 'I will come back to save you,' he whispered in his heart: 'Wait for me, until I have enough strength.'"

choices.description: "Proactively expose your position, drawing away the Eye of Heavenly Fate's attention, buying Mo Xiansheng a chance to escape"
choices.visible_reward: "Mo Xiansheng temporarily escapes danger, owing you a life-saving favor"

text.content: "Chen Ji abruptly rose to his feet, explosively projecting a blinding signal outward with his divine sense. In that instant, his aura was like a torch in the darkness, clearly transmitting into the distance—to a corner of Cang Yutian's domain, to some existence currently monitoring this place. 'Come find me then!' he coldly laughed in his heart. Meanwhile, that chain of fate paused slightly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul seized this moment, abruptly breaking free, plunging into the deepest part of the Tianji Record."

"In the Mental Sea, those eyes of fate slowly turned toward Chen Ji, carrying a predator-like playfulness. 'Interesting...' that cold voice rang out again, but with an added chill: 'You are quite willing to sacrifice. To rescue a remnant soul, you exposed your position without hesitation? It seems you are harder to control than Cang Yutian anticipated.' Chen Ji felt an icy chill seeping into his soul along that gaze, as if an invisible hand was plucking at his threads of fate."

"'Remember this gaze of today.' The voice cut like ice: 'From this moment, everything about you is before this seat's eyes. Every encounter, every choice, every drop of Heavenly Fate consumed—this seat will be watching.' The words fell. Those eyes of fate slowly dissipated, but before vanishing completely, they left Chen Ji with words that sent chills down his spine: 'Cang Yutian thought you could become his blade—and this seat, would like to see who this blade will ultimately pierce.'"

"The void returned to dead silence. Chen Ji slumped to the ground, cold sweat already soaking his inner garments. The pages of the Tianji Record had returned to calm, yet the undercurrents within were more turbulent than ever. He looked down at the fragment in his palm, his heart filled with mixed emotions—the Fate Scribe's guidance, Cang Yutian's ambitions, the Eye of Heavenly Fate's gaze, and that true saying of 'refusing to be chosen'—all the clues intertwined in his mind like a tangled mess, yet隐隐 pointing in the same direction."

"Just then, the first page of the Tianji Record faintly glowed. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul weakly emerged at a corner. His voice was hoarse and weary, yet carried a trace of relief: 'Chen Ji... it's good that you're unharmed.' He paused, seeming to use all his strength to speak one final sentence: 'The fifth page... not far away... it has always been...' Before he could finish, the remnant soul dimmed again, falling into deep slumber. This slumber of Mo Xiansheng's would likely prevent him from offering guidance for a considerable time."

"Chen Ji held the Tianji Record, his gaze deep and dark. Mo Xiansheng's words were only half-spoken—the fifth page has always been? Always within the Tianji Record? Or always on his person? Or perhaps... that answer of 'always being here' was more mysterious than he could imagine. He slowly rose to his feet, walking toward the window. Night had deepfallen. On the Main Peak of Tianqing Sect in the distance, lanterns were brightly lit, as if some major event was unfolding. And he, the inheritor of the Tianji Record, had just become the brightest and most dangerous piece in this chess game of heaven and earth."

"Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Tianji Record into his chest. No matter how perilous the road ahead, he had already resolved—he would not be manipulated by any chess player, even if that player was an existence governing fate itself. 'Refusing to be chosen...' he quietly repeated these words, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: 'Very well, let me show you all how large a chessboard a waste can overturn.' Outside the window, the night wind rose suddenly. A storm sufficient to shake the entire cultivation world was quietly brewing. What Chen Ji did not know was that in the very same instant he made his vow, at a certain secret location of Cang Yutian, a pair of bloodshot eyes was死死盯着 his direction—an existence more dangerous than the eyes of fate, had already locked onto him."
